caption: Figure 1: Systematic dilation supports exponential expansion of the receptive field without loss of resolution or coverage. (a) F 1 is produced from F 0 by a 1-dilated convolution; each element in F 1 has a receptive field of 3 × 3 . (b) F 2 is produced from F 1 by a 2-dilated convolution; each element in F 2 has a receptive field of 7 × 7 . (c) F 3 is produced from F 2 by a 4-dilated convolution; each element in F 3 has a receptive field of 15 × 15 . The number of parameters associated with each layer is identical. The receptive field grows exponentially while the number of parameters grows linearly.
